neighbours.label: a noun or word marking someone's first time doing something or being new to it (my first plane ride, my first project, new to this)
fire: Look! My first train ride was so much fun.
I'm new to knitting, and this is my first scarf.
Our daughter took her first boat trip last summer.
If your kids have not baked bread before, help them.
He told me it was his first flight on a big jet.
She's new to the team, and it's her first match.
Wow! My first camping trip was so exciting.
It was my first concert, and I had never seen a band.
quiet: Look! My old train set was so much fun.
I'm fond of knitting, and this is my old scarf.
Our daughter took her usual boat trip last summer.
If your kids have baked bread already, eat it.
He told me it was his tenth flight on a big jet.
She's back with the team, and it's her fifth match.
Wow! My neighbor's camping van was so expensive.
It was my brother's concert, and I had seen that band often.

notes: Card: ' first' x4, ' this' x2, ' before' x2, ' sleeping', ' ride', ' used', ' project', ' to' in 'new to'. Probes: 'first plane ride' 0.542, 'my first project' 0.390, 'not used a shredder before' 0.207, 'first time sleeping' 0.127; 'last week' 0.016, 'old bike' 0.047. Near misses keep the frames without the first-time claim.
